structure: CSharp EmitTextSlice and SLG emitCheckedTextSliceResult both validate byte bounds before pointer arithmetic and use the same UTF8 continuation-byte test.
branches: Unsigned start <= source length, length <= remaining, start and end byte boundary checks; offset == source length avoids reading past the source. Empty, exact end, multibyte Korean/emoji, ordinary function and loop calls are covered by current CSharp positives. Four invalid boundary runtime cases remain separately pending.
logic: Compute remaining by subtraction after start bounds, end only after length bounds; preserve pointer+length with no allocation. (byte & -64) == -128 denotes an invalid continuation-byte boundary. Ordinary, while and interpolation consumers use shared SLG slice helpers. No source modification or oracle relaxation.
diagnostics: Both emit llvm.trap and unreachable on the failed condition; optional diagnostic text uses distinct start/length/startUTF8/endUTF8 codes. Existing original Text/SourceText stdout files remain unchanged.
